facts.fact: OPaís reports, from the Executive's report annexed to the 2025 state budget, that common-jurisdiction courts will start this year an integrated information-management and document-dematerialisation system, with over Kz 1 billion for the judicial council (CSMJ).
facts.system: sistema de gestão integrado de informação e desmaterialização documental

AGO.note: Police stations are mentioned only in a judges' association call to digitise from esquadras to courts; no police system is stated.
